sources.title: Sun and Moon Pagodas Guilin: Copper & Glass Twin Towers with Underwater Tunnel & Nightly Light Spectacle
sources.content:
Sun and Moon Pagodas Guilin - Complete Text Content

Overview
"The Sun and Moon Pagodas, nestled in the heart of Guilin's Shan Lake Scenic Area, are the iconic twin towers of China's 'Two Rivers and Four Lakes' water system." The golden Sun Pagoda stands 41 meters tall as the world's tallest copper tower, crafted from 350 tons of pure copper with an elevator. The silver Moon Pagoda measures 35 meters high as a seven-story glass structure, connected via an 18-meter underwater tunnel. Designated a 5A national tourist attraction, they showcase panoramic views and nightly light spectacles.

Historical Background
Originally constructed in 750 CE by Master Jianzhen during the Tang Dynasty, the towers housed Sun and Moon Bodhisattva statues. They were destroyed during late Tang wars. Tang-era underground chambers with precious artifacts were discovered in 1999. "The modern copper-and-glass towers, completed in 2001, inherit the 'Sun and Moon' name while incorporating advanced anti-seismic foundations and nano-coating for longevity." The structures experienced a 2014 fire incident followed by restoration.

Architecture & Layout
The complex follows a north-south axis with three sections: Waterfront Plaza for cultural performances, Pagoda Zone featuring both towers, and landscape integration with Shan Lake's lotus ponds and willow-lined paths. Key features include the 18-meter underwater corridor with fish-viewing windows and the Sun Pagoda's 9th-floor observation deck.

Major Attractions
- Sun Pagoda: 41-meter copper tower with elevator access to the 9th floor
- Moon Pagoda: 35-meter glass tower displaying Ming Dynasty blue-and-white porcelain murals
- Underwater Corridor: Glass-enclosed tunnel revealing lake life and Tang relics
- Cultural Hall: Bamboo-leaf steles and harmony stone carvings
- Night Light Show: Evening displays from 19:00-23:00

Suggested Itineraries
Classic Route (2-3 hours): Photography, underwater corridor exploration, Moon Pagoda drum plaza, Sun Pagoda panoramic views, then evening light show.
Extended Route (4-5 hours): Sun Pagoda elevator tour, Moon Pagoda basement artifacts, Four Lakes cruise, Elephant Trunk Hill connection.
Comprehensive Route (Full Day): Morning tea at Sun Pagoda, cultural exhibits, Shan Lake cycling, evening light show, night market exploration.

Ticket Information
Online: Book via official WeChat mini-program or travel platforms up to 7 days ahead.
On-site: Limited tickets at entrance; holiday queues peak.
Pricing:
- Peak Season (Apr-Oct): ¥55 adults, ¥27 students
- Off-season: ¥27 adults
- Free: Children under 1.2m, disabled visitors, active military
- Combination tickets available with Four Lakes cruise and Elephant Hill

Transportation
By Bus: Routes 2/5/16/23/88 to Wenming Road Station or Xiangshan Park Station
By Subway: Line 1 to Zhongshan Road Station, then 10-minute walk
By Taxi: Direct to Shan Lake East Entrance; parking at nearby shopping malls

Best Times & Visitor Tips
Peak Hours: Avoid 10 AM-2 PM; visit early (8:30 AM opening) or after 3 PM.
Seasons: Spring (Apr-May) for blooms; autumn (Oct-Nov) for crisp air.
Essentials: Walking shoes recommended for 20,000+ steps, carry water bottles, use tripods for night photography.
Prohibited: Selfie sticks, drones, large bags; no flash in galleries.
Local Recommendation: Combine visit with nearby Zhengyang Pedestrian Street for dining experiences.

sources.title: The Sun and Moon Pagodas in Guilin
sources.content:
The Sun and Moon Pagodas in Guilin

Location & Access: "Inside Fir Lake Scenic Area, Wenming Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin" with approximately 30 minutes walking time from Sheraton Hotel via Liberation Bridge.

Operating Information: Hours: 08:00-22:00 daily. Entry fees range from RMB25-55. Allow approximately one hour for the visit.

Architecture & Features: The Sun Pagoda stands "41 meters high" with "9 stories" and is constructed of bronze. The Moon Pagoda measures 39 meters and utilizes colored glaze materials. "A 10-meter glass tunnel links the two underwater," allowing visitors to observe aquatic life while crossing between structures.

Significance: The Sun Pagoda holds distinction as "the world's highest bronze pagoda" and "the world's highest pagoda above water." Both towers combine cultural, religious, and technological elements within a scenic lakeside setting.

Visitor Recommendations: Evening visits are strongly encouraged when illumination transforms the towers into golden and silver displays reflecting across Fir Lake's waters. Upon climbing either pagoda, visitors encounter "various statues of Buddhists and other historical and cultural symbols" alongside panoramic downtown views.

Nearby Attractions: Fubo Hill, Elephant Trunk Hill, Diecai Hill, and Zhengyang Pedestrian Street.

sources.title: Sun and Moon Twins Pagoda Guilin
sources.content:
Sun and Moon Pagodas - Guilin: Complete Text Content

Overview
The Sun and Moon Pagodas (also called Gold and Silver Pagodas) are located in Shanhu Lake in Guilin's inner city. They represent "a combination of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism" and serve as cultural symbols of the region. Originally constructed during the Tang Dynasty, the structures were rebuilt in 2001.

Operating Information
- Hours: 8:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- Location: Shanhu Lake Scenic Area, Wenming Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin, Guangxi
- Note: Lights turn off at 11:00 PM

Sun Pagoda Details
The Sun Pagoda reaches approximately 41 meters across 9 stories. Made entirely from bronze (350 tons used), it appears golden in color. Key features include:
- "highest brass pagoda in the world, and the highest pagoda standing in a lake"
- Elevator access to the 6th level
- First floor contains a brass bell for prayers
- Tea houses on floors 1-2
- Sheli (cremation remains) exhibitions on floors 8-9
- Top floor offers panoramic lake views

Moon Pagoda Details
Standing 35 meters tall with 7 stories, the Moon Pagoda features glazed tile decoration in silver tones. Highlights include:
- Ornate carvings with thematic meanings per floor
- Buddhist and Taoist exhibitions
- Stone tablets with inscriptions
- Seventh floor dedicated to Yue Lao (god of love and marriage)

Underwater Connection
An 18-meter glass tunnel links both pagodas beneath the lake, allowing visitors to observe "the leisure of fish and beautiful scenery" through arched glass viewing areas.

Cultural Elements
The pagodas contain bronze statues of Sakyamuni, Confucius, and Laozi. Notable stone inscriptions include:
- Bamboo leaf tablets (poems forming visual images)
- Sakyamuni's footprint carvings
- Portrayal tablets mixing three philosophical figures
- "Qian nian shou tablet" featuring thousand variations of three characters in multiple script styles

Visitor Activities
- Sunset viewing around Shanhu Lake
- Night strolling to experience golden and silver illumination
- Photography in minority characteristic clothing
- Night cruising the Two Rivers and Four Lakes system
- Enjoying summer breezes lakeside

Nearby Attractions
- Elephant Trunk Hill (iconic Guilin landmark)
- Zhengyang Pedestrian Street
- East West Lane (Ming Dynasty architecture)
- Binjiang Road (scenic waterfront promenade)
- Xiaoyao Tower

sources.title: Sun and Moon Pagodas - Wikipedia
sources.content:
The Sun and Moon Pagodas are a pair of pagodas situated in Shanhu Lake in the city center of Guilin, Guangxi, China. They are a landmark of the city. The Sun Pagoda is made of copper, 41 meters tall with 9 stories, while the Moon Pagoda is made of marble, 35 meters tall with 7 stories. The two pagodas are connected by an underwater passage.

You don't need to pay an admission fee to see the Sun and Moon Twin Pagodas from the surrounding park. The views from the lakefront are free and offer a fantastic experience.

sources.title: Sun & Moon Pagodas: Guilin | Visions of Travel
sources.content:
Sun & Moon Pagodas, Guilin

Located on Shan Hu Lake in the city center, the Sun and Moon Pagodas are two iconic landmarks of Guilin that are truly enchanting, especially at night when they are illuminated and reflect their colors on the lake. They are also known as Gold and Silver Pagodas because of their colors at night.

The golden Sun Pagoda, standing 41 meters tall as the world's tallest copper tower, is crafted from 350 tons of pure copper with a vertical elevator. The silver Moon Pagoda, a 35-meter-high seven-story glass tower, connects to the Sun Pagoda via an 18-meter underwater tunnel.

The experience is most magical at night when the pagodas are illuminated and reflect on the lake. During the day, it's a pleasant park for a stroll and to admire the architecture. Allow about one hour of visit.

When you climb the two pagodas you will see various statues of Buddhists and other historical and cultural symbols. While standing on top of the Sun or the Moon Pagoda, you will see downtown Guilin at night.

Top tip: visit at sunset to watch the sun go down behind the stunning pagodas. The attraction is gorgeous at night because of the lights which would be turned off at 23:00 o'clock.

During peak season (April-October), adult tickets cost ¥55 and student tickets are ¥27, while off-season adult tickets cost ¥27. Children under 1.2m, disabled visitors, and active military enter for free.

sources.title: 日月双塔_百度百科
sources.content:
日月双塔 - 百度百科

基本信息
日月双塔位于广西桂林市中心杉湖景区，由日塔和月塔组成，是两江四湖环城水系的核心景观。

建筑特征
日塔："高41米，为9层铜塔，通体以350吨纯铜建造，设有电梯"。该塔创造三项世界纪录——最高铜塔、最高铜质建筑物、最高水中塔。
月塔：高35米，共七层琉璃塔。两塔通过湖底隧道相连，游客可通过地下水族通道往来。

历史发展
双塔始建于唐代，2001年重建为融合儒释道文化的主题公园。地宫展出唐代佛塔文物及佛教密宗文化。2014年日塔曾遭火灾但随后修复开放。

文化特色
公园融合"儒释道"三教文化，展示各类石刻珍品，包括"竹叶碑""混元三教九流图赞碑"等。园区为"中国第一家以儒释道之和为主题的文化公园"。

游览信息
- 开放时间：全年08:00-22:00
- 门票：27-55元
- 交通：公交2、5、16、23、88、208路可达

夜间灯光景观突出，登塔可俯瞰桂林城区及象鼻山等景点。

sources.title: 桂林日月双塔游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content:
日月双塔游玩攻略（携程）

景点地址：桂林市象山区文明路10号
开放时间：09:00-17:00
门市价格：35元/人，网上预订价格为28元

1.19米以下、70岁及以上老人免票；1.2米-1.4米儿童、60-70岁老人门市半价。

日月双塔位于广西桂林市中心杉湖景区，由日塔与月塔组成。日塔高41米，为9层铜塔，通体以350吨纯铜建造，设有电梯，创世界最高铜塔、最高水中塔等三项纪录；月塔高35米，为7层琉璃塔，两塔通过湖底隧道相连。

游玩攻略：
1. 最佳观赏时间：推荐夜晚来欣赏夜景，9层高的日塔放射出的是金色的光亮，7层高的月塔散发的是银色的光芒
2. 交通方式：可乘2、23路公交车到象山公园站下车步行到杉湖知音台码头即到
3. 游览体验：从塔顶俯瞰，桂林城秀美的湖光山色尽收眼底。南面为杉湖小广场，东面是知音台，北面是日月湾，西面有阳桥、玻璃桥等形态各异的桥梁
4. 两江四湖游船：游船分白天和晚上两个时段，白天价格90元，夜游180元

sources.title: 日月双塔文化公园旅游攻略 - 知乎
sources.content:
日月双塔文化公园旅游攻略

日月双塔文化公园坐落于桂林市中心区，是桂林市的标志性建筑之一。公园以两座高大的塔楼为核心，分别被称为日塔和月塔，代表着太阳和月亮。日塔为铜塔，高41米；月塔为琉璃塔，高35米。两塔之间有一条18米长的水下隧道相连。

公园融合了中国传统文化中的儒、释、道三教元素，是"中国第一家以儒释道之和为主题的文化公园"。园内展示有大量历代石刻艺术精品，包括竹叶碑、混元三教九流图赞碑等珍贵文物。

参观建议：白天可以仔细欣赏塔内的文物展览和建筑细节；傍晚时分是拍照的最佳时间；夜晚的灯光秀最为壮观。建议游览时间1-2小时。
